description: This file defines a Go package for configuring Kubernetes Taint objects declaratively, including a struct and builder methods for setting its fields.

classes.name: TaintApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration for a Kubernetes Taint, with fields for key, value, effect, and time added.

methods.name: Taint
methods.description: Constructor function that returns a new instance of TaintApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithKey
methods.description: Sets the Key field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithValue
methods.description: Sets the Value field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithEffect
methods.description: Sets the Effect field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithTimeAdded
methods.description: Sets the TimeAdded field in the configuration.
